chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi narrated to us, Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Sulaiman Abu al-Fadl narrated to me, Dawud ibn Rashid narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Tha'labi al-Mawsili Abu Nawfal narrated to us, who said: I heard Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them, saying:
We are the chosen ones of Allah from His creation, and our Shi'ah are the chosen ones of Allah from the ummah of His Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny.

key_terms.أمة نبيه: the ummah of His Prophet - The community of Prophet Muhammad, from which the Shi'ah are selected as elect
key_terms.خيرة الله: the chosen ones of Allah - Divine selection (istifa), a Quranic concept applied here to both the Imams and their followers
key_terms.شيعتنا: our Shi'ah - The Imams' community, distinguished from the general Muslim ummah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq say about the Shi'ah being chosen by Allah?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, declares: 'We are the chosen ones of Allah from His creation, and our Shi'ah are the chosen ones of Allah from the ummah of His Prophet.' This concise statement from al-Amali al-Mufid establishes a dual election: the Imams are selected by God from all creation, and the Shi'ah are selected from Muhammad's community. The term khiyarah (chosen/elect) echoes the Quranic concept of istifa (divine selection), used for prophets and their families (Q 3:33). The statement was directed at the Shi'ah community during a period of marginalization, affirming their special status in God's plan.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me from Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Sulaiman Abul Fadhl, who reported from Dawood ibn Rushaid, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Tha’labi al-Mosili Abu Nawfil, who said: I heard Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, say: "
We are the Chosen ones by Allah among His creation, and our Shi’ahs are His Chosen ones from the Ummah of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his progeny."
